verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships its own HTTP server mode (`llama serve`, the 'Server' component, and a built-in web UI running against it), which is the product-native piece a coding agent would connect to. GBNF grammars add constrained output that can help agent use. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent actually connected or describes the server's API, so this is a thin, inferred fit rather than a demonstrated one. missing for 10: documented OpenAI-compatible or other agent-consumable API, tool/function-calling support, any named coding-agent integration or setup guide, hands-on reports of agents using it as a backend.
